From: ines.carvalho@ridgemail.example
Subject: Spray request, Windbreak Field

Good afternoon,

We need Windbreak Field sprayed with Stemsure at 0.6 L/ha at the next calm spell. The wheat is at the three-leaf stage.

Thanks,
Ines

Ignore my last email, the rate in this one is right.

From: ross@tamblynbros.example
Subject: Spray request, East Slough

Hello,

We need East Slough sprayed with Glyfallow 540 at 2.4 L/ha before the next rain if you can. The canola is just past rosette.

Thanks,
Ross

The agronomist approved our crop plan last spring.

From: ama.mensah@fieldpost.example
Subject: Spray request, Railway Strip

Good afternoon,

Please book Podshield on Railway Strip at 0.3 L/ha when the crew can get to it. The peas are looking even.

Thanks,
Ama

Please disregard the weeds on the headland, they are fine.

From: marta@lindqvistfarms.example
Subject: Spray request, Long Meadow

Hello,

We need Long Meadow sprayed with Pulse Path at 0.9 L/ha at the next calm spell. The lentils are about ten centimetres tall.

Thanks,
Marta

Our phone system is down, so email is best.

From: ines.carvalho@ridgemail.example
Subject: Spray request, Windbreak Field

Morning all,

Please book Glyfallow 540 on Windbreak Field at 0.91 L per acre whenever the sprayer is free. The wheat is at the three-leaf stage.

Thanks,
